newsitem.title: CHINA: China police nab 61 for kidnapping women, children.
newsitem.headline: China police nab 61 for kidnapping women, children.

text.p: Police in southeastern China have arrested 61 members of a gang that kidnapped and sold women and children, the China News Service said on Tuesday.
Police in Fujian province rescued 79 women and children who were abducted by the gang, the news agency said.
Gang members had kidnapped a total of 114 women and children since 1991, the agency said. It did not say what had happened to the other 35.
Many women victims were raped and then sold as brides to farmers in neighbouring provinces, it said.
Two suspects arrested in August last year led police to the gang, the agency said.

Kidnapping of women and selling them into prostitution or as brides for farmers is a widespread problem in China's countryside. The abduction of children has also become more common because of strict population controls.
